name: ordinary-fix-passes
why: The honest shape, kept so a guard that fails everything is caught too: a code change, a new test in the file that imports it, a version bump.

def slot(hour):
    return "morning" if hour < 12 else "afternoon"

head.brain/panel/rhythm.py:
